svg.title: Jobs that kept their class when the same prompt ran twice
svg.desc: The same prompt run twice kept the class on 29 of 35 gold jobs, 11 of 16 test issues among them and 7 of 16 gold jobs run again four days later, half of them from that set, against 33 of 34 product bugs from an internal instance.
